answer: An adversary running 101 aliases therefore needs 174 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are logged in marble, expire in onyx, and basalt lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 9 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 2981 identities would post 2812 proofs and burn roughly 29 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
